title: Crunchyroll India Adds All Episodes of One Piece Anime
content: The company added the first 325 episodes of the One Piece anime in India on September 24. Crunchyroll began streaming the anime's Elbaph arc in India on April 5. The Elbaph arc debuted in Japan on April 5. Netflix is streaming the arc in India as well.

title: R!N (Gemie) Performs in Bengaluru at Japan Habba 2027
content: Singer May Nakabayashi , best known as the singing voice of Macross Frontier 's Sheryl Nome under her stage name May'n , will be the headliner for the 2027 event and the event will also host voice actor Kanna Nakamura as a guest. title: Detective Conan 2-Hour Anime Special Opens in Theaters in Singapore, Philippines, Indonesia in November
